summary: The phase delivers the harness, datasets, scorer, budget guard and holdout manifest guard, all re-verified. The quality misses (fallback M2 47.5%, holdout M1c 3.07%, live M4 8/10) are real and still open. They are disclosed and the thresholds are unweakened. They are bound by registered risks RISK-13/14/15, which the engine shows as open, so they cannot ship silently. I accept this as an adequate substitute for the plan amendment only because the verification gate must re-check them. This approval does not claim the quality thresholds are met.

criteria.description: Harness, scorer, budget guard and holdout isolation are correct (re-run)
Unmet items are honestly disclosed, thresholds not weakened, and the fallback miss reproduces as reported
Resolution of the misses is tracked so it cannot be silently shipped (engine risk register, surfaced at verification)

findings.title: Carry-forward: RISK-13/14/15 are risk-register controls, not plan criteria
findings.detail: Nothing in the plan makes live-eval fail if the two todo tests stay in place. The risk register is the only binding control. Reviewer re-run of the fallback eval (ev:ev-mv02w1xn-01806044, exit 1) reproduced M2 at 47.5%, as disclosed.
findings.recommendation: At the verification gate, do not approve unless (a) the todo in test/eval/fallback-tune.test.js and the todo in test/eval/m1b-m1c.test.js are gone and their assertions pass, or (b) each remaining miss is explicitly reported to the user with a recorded decision. Also require one holdout re-run after the last tuning change and the README D10 gap list.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Mitigated, not resolved as originally defined. The plan gate is user-only and the plan was not amended. The misses are bound by open RISK-13/14/15 with the controls (a)-(e) in the submission, and the verification gate must re-check them (see F5). The fallback M2 miss was re-run and reproduces at 47.5%, so it is neither hidden nor weakened.
Accepted. live-eval is instructed not to consult holdout item ids and to state so in the tuning log. The harness output is unchanged, which is acceptable for a minor finding.
Accepted. The gap is assigned to the README D10 open-risks section (docs-devops) and listed in RISK-14.
Info only. live-eval commits to passing --max-cost 1.5 on every run.
